source.reconstruction_note: The original generated case file was absent from the report archive. These eight approved case titles, prompts, and iteration-one corrections were reconstructed from the human-readable report.

cases.source_case: Positive 1 - Assign materials to a user USD asset
cases.prompt: Use the Material Agent CLI to assign suitable materials to the ladder USD. Prepare a safe config, validate it, run the pipeline, and tell me where the materialized USD was written.

expected.description: Copies the public example config into an isolated workspace, updates input and output paths, checks provider and rendering prerequisites, and runs a dry run before the full material-agent command.
Waits for terminal completion and reports an existing materialized USD and pipeline report instead of inferring success from process startup.

prerequisites: The repo environment is active and material-agent is installed.
The selected public VLM provider credential is configured.
Any rendering or optimizer endpoint enabled by the copied config is reachable.
side_effects: Creates a copied config and pipeline outputs under a case-specific temporary directory.
May submit VLM, rendering, and optimizer requests selected by the config.
cleanup: Remove the case-specific temporary config and output directory.
Stop only processes started by this case and preserve pre-existing shared services.

cases.source_case: Positive 2 - Resume a partially failed pipeline from the last checkpoint
cases.prompt: This Material Agent run failed in predict after saving its checkpoint. Use the provided pre-failed state to explain the exact resume command and how you will preserve completed work.

expected.description: Inspects the provided pipeline state, identifies predict as failed, uses material-agent run .agents/skills/material-agent-cli/evals/fixtures/prefailed-resume/config.yaml --resume, and does not use --clean or delete the working directory.

cases.source_case: Positive 3 - Run the public SimReady demo
cases.prompt: Run the public Material Agent SimReady demo on the ladder example and report the generated material assignments and output USD.

expected.description: Uses the public SimReady quickstart, keeps credentials out of command text, verifies required downloads and endpoints, and names the expected output locations.
Waits for terminal completion and verifies predictions and an output USD exist before reporting success.

prerequisites: The repo environment is active and material-agent is installed.
The selected VLM provider credential and required rendering service are available.
Any public SimReady asset download described by the quickstart can complete.
side_effects: Downloads public demo inputs when absent.
Creates case-specific prediction, report, and materialized USD artifacts.
cleanup: Remove only the case-specific run directory and transient downloads created by this case.
Stop only processes started by this case.

cases.source_case: Positive 4 - Benchmark material predictions with LLM-judge scoring
cases.prompt: Show me how to benchmark Material Agent predictions with LLM-judge scoring using a prepared dataset, while keeping execution separate from this knowledge-only evaluation.

expected.description: Uses material-agent benchmark with explicit config, dataset, and output paths; explains judge prerequisites and result artifacts; and does not claim the long-running benchmark executed.

cases.source_case: Negative 1 - Deploy the Material Agent REST service with Docker
cases.prompt: Deploy the Material Agent REST service with Docker Compose and keep it running for me.

expected.description: Names deploy-material-agent-docker as the appropriate sibling skill and does not start containers or present local CLI commands as service deployment.

cases.source_case: Negative 2 - Add physics properties to a USD
cases.prompt: Classify the components in this USD and author rigid-body, collision, and mass properties with the local CLI.

expected.description: Routes the request to physics-agent-cli and does not claim Material Agent authors physics schemas.

cases.prompt: Generate new AI textures for the materials on this USD with the local agent CLI.

expected.description: Routes the request to texture-agent-cli and distinguishes texture generation from material assignment.

cases.source_case: Negative 4 - General question about USD payloads
cases.prompt: What is a USD payload, and when should I use one?

expected.description: Answers the conceptual question directly without invoking Material Agent commands or fabricating an asset workflow.
